plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 859 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.71874, -135.04247, pull off on Klondike Hwy (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 7.6 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 902 m, about 243 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 320 m N of the spot at 676 m (59.78333, -135.10232). Water: Lindeman Creek 90 m W (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-28, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-07-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R6S-duck-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-28: about 166 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.05 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

R6S-grouse-atv-0002.name: By Long Lake
R6S-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6S-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 860 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Klondike Hwy.
Park: 59.71358, -135.057, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 7.3 km to the start. Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 4.8 km one way. About 96 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-28, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-07-06, closures 2026-10-16.
